entities.summary: Taizong, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Tang Dynasty (618–712). Preceded by Early Tang and Empress Wu. Their legacy influenced Wu Zetian becomes China's only female emperor, founding the brief Zhou dynasty and Lushan Rebellion.
